summary: Master construction procurement and contract administration with practical tools, contract control, and tender workflows. Enroll to strengthen project commercia
lede: Construction procurement and contract administration covers tender planning, bid evaluation, and control of contract changes and payments. It is designed for professionals handling construction contracts, procurement, and project records, with practical work on clause review, payment registers, variation and claims logs, and contract closeout; the syllabus also introduces digital document control and AI-assisted contract file review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with construction contracts, procurement files, or project delivery records and need stronger commercial control.
modules: Construction Procurement and Contract Administration Foundations
Contract Clause Analysis and Risk Allocation
prerequisites: You need a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and familiarity with common construction documents such as tender packages, contracts, payment applications, and variation instructions. Experience in projects, procurement, quantity surveying, or site administration will help you apply the exercises faster.
